info.name: What the Blue King Goblin Wants

descriptions.notStarted: The Guardian Spirit says the Goblins of Kamak Mountain are the only ones that know something about the Old Fox. Go see the #bBlue King Goblin#k at #bDokebi House#k near the Haunted House.
descriptions.inProgress: The Blue King Goblin says he will tell everything about the Old Fox only if I get him #b1 bottle#k of his favorite #brice wine#k. Let's go buy rice wine from the Folk Town.  \n\n#i2022052##t2022052#  #b#c2022052##k/1
descriptions.completed: The Blue King Goblin revealed where the Old Fox appears.
